items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had a hit, pretty much a big hit, not as big as Mr. Magic, but he had a hit before that.

ctx.x: Ralph McDonald. He had a hit, pretty much a big hit, not as big as Mr. Magic, but he had a hit before that. I can’t remember the title of it. I didn’t play on that record, but I did play a lot on Mr. Magic when we were on tour. Grover, I remember – you know the story behind Grover, how he got to play – record with CTI?
